Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit false is honored.
strikethrough_break_spaces.title: Strikethrough Break Spaces

v_center_chars.description: Character set auto-centred vertically between the baseline and the capline: every text character occurring in this string is raised or lowered (a pure vertical translate) so its own ink is centred on the cap-band midline (half the rendered cap height above the baseline) - the characters a font typically draws too high (hyphen, colon, en/em dash, '=', '<', '>'). The inline <vc>...</vc> markup tag applies the same centering to any other characters it wraps. Empty string '' disables the auto-apply (the <vc> tag keeps working on its own). Cascades line -> label -> job (code fallback '' = auto-apply off; job-config.json ships the shop set '-:–—=<>'); an explicit '' is honored.
v_center_chars.title: V Center Chars

cutter_size.description: Cutter diameter in inches to use for this text instead of the tool auto-selected from text_height. Snapped to the shop inventory (tools.json available_cutters: next size down, else next size up); the rendered toolpath height becomes text_height - cutter_size. Omit (null) to keep automatic cutter selection from text_height. Must be > 0 and below the line's text_height. No job-config.json counterpart. Cascades line -> label -> job.
cutter_size.title: Cutter Size

target_boldness_factor.description: Target engraved stroke width as a fraction of text height for multi-stroke (bold) PLT fonts - fonts whose glyphs carry N > 1 parallel cutter passes (the stroke_count stored in the font's catalog file). The automatic cutter is sized so the N passes plus their overlaps engrave this total width, with multistroke_overlap_ratio guarding against unengraved stripes; the resulting cutter is snapped to the shop inventory. The implicit pass overlap is derived and logged. Inert on single-stroke fonts, TTF fonts, and lines with an explicit cutter_size. Bound to [0.05, 0.30]. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.14); accepted on plates for schema parity only.
target_boldness_factor.title: Target Boldness Factor

multistroke_overlap_ratio.description: Minimum overlap fraction between adjacent cutter passes of a multi-stroke (bold) PLT font: the automatic cutter is never smaller than pass_spacing / (1 - this ratio), so adjacent engraved strokes always overlap by at least this fraction and no unengraved stripe can appear between passes (an overlap of 0.25 means the stepover stays within 75% of the cutter width). The actual overlap is derived from the chosen cutter and logged. Inert on single-stroke fonts, TTF fonts, and lines with an explicit cutter_size. Bound to [0.1, 0.5]. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.25); accepted on plates for schema parity only.
multistroke_overlap_ratio.title: Multistroke Overlap Ratio

bold_boldness_multiplier.description: Boldness boost applied by inline <b> markup to a multi-stroke (bold) PLT font: the bold runs re-run the cutter ladder at target_boldness_factor * this multiplier (clamped to 0.30 with a WARNING), so their parallel passes engrave heavier than the line's plain text. On single-stroke PLT and TTF fonts <b> instead steps to the next larger inventory cutter and this multiplier is inert. Bound to [1.0, 4.0]; 1.0 disables the boost. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.5); accepted on plates for schema parity only.
bold_boldness_multiplier.title: Bold Boldness Multiplier

cutter_downsize.description: Allow the automatically selected cutter to be reduced when the text line is horizontally compressed: a line squeezed past the midpoint toward the next smaller inventory tool swaps to it and re-renders at text_height - smaller_cutter. One-way (a downsized cutter is never enlarged again within the same line) and fully overridden by an explicit cutter_size. Requires a tools.json available_cutters inventory. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
cutter_downsize.title: Cutter Downsize

max_cutter_downsizes.description: Maximum number of successive cutter downsizings applied to one text line (0 disables the mechanism, 1 = at most one size down). Each step re-measures the line, since a smaller cutter renders wider. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1); explicit 0 is honored.
max_cutter_downsizes.title: Max Cutter Downsizes

cutter_downsize_global.description: Share a compression-driven cutter downsize across the text lines of one label: when a line's compression triggers a swap to a smaller inventory tool, every other eligible line of the same text_height in the same label receives the same swap (then each continues its own one-way step loop). Lines with an explicit cutter_size, cutter_downsize false, max_cutter_downsizes 0, or a zero max_h_compress budget are never touched. Setting the option at the job level enables it for every label; sharing is always per-label. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
cutter_downsize_global.title: Cutter Downsize Global

cutter_downsize_global_job_wide.description: Widen the scope of the shared cutter downsize from the label to the whole job: when a line's compression triggers a swap, every eligible line of the same text_height in ANY label of the job receives the same swap (the job converges on one tool per text size). Requires cutter_downsize_global true; a line with this flag false keeps exactly the per-label behaviour (it neither shares to nor receives from the job-wide group). The same eligibility opt-outs apply. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit true is honored.
cutter_downsize_global_job_wide.title: Cutter Downsize Global Job Wide

h_compress_global.description: Share horizontal compression across the text lines of one label: when a line's width forces horizontal compression, every other eligible line of the same text_height in the same label is compressed to the same scale (the most-compressed scale among the triggering lines, clamped to each line's own max_h_compress budget floor). Lines with a zero max_h_compress budget are never touched. Setting the option at the job level enables it for every label; sharing is always per-label. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit true is honored.
h_compress_global.title: H Compress Global

h_compress_global_same_height_only.description: The grouping scope of the shared horizontal compression: true (the default) shares the compression only between the lines of the same text_height in the label (one text size, one glyph density); false shares it across EVERY eligible line of the label, whatever their text_height, so one label engraves at one glyph density throughout. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
h_compress_global_same_height_only.title: H Compress Global Same Height Only

arc_preserve_compression.description: Keep PLT-font glyphs arc-native through the non-uniform text transforms (horizontal compression, the cap-line clamp, the descender relief and the italic shear): each arc's ellipse image is refit with a short chain of circular AA arcs (bounded deviation, see plt_optimizer/generate/arc_fit.py) instead of polygonizing into line segments, so a compressed line engraves far faster. True (the default) preserves arcs; false restores the historical polygonized output. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
arc_preserve_compression.title: Arc Preserve Compression

optimize_line_content.description: Redistribute this line's words across the consecutive lines that also enable the option: whole words move between the enabled lines of the group (word order is never changed, only the line breaks) so the group's lines reach equal rendered width, minimizing the horizontal compression the label would otherwise need. Consecutive enabled lines form one independent group; a disabled line breaks the group. Runs as an export pre-pass before the cutter-reduction and shared-compression pre-passes. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit true is honored.
optimize_line_content.title: Optimize Line Content

optimize_line_content_max_lines.description: Ceiling N on how many consecutive lines an optimize_line_content group may use. This option can only ever ADD lines to a label; it never removes, blanks or collapses one. Unset reflows across the group's existing lines and adds none. When set, the reflow starts at the group's existing line count G and grows the group (inserting lines cloned from the group's typography) until its lines need no horizontal compression, M reaches N, or M reaches the group's word count. N <= G leaves the cap inert. Setting it on any one line of a group applies it to the whole group; two different values in one group are an error, and so is specifying it while optimize_line_content is not enabled. Cascades line -> label -> job (unset by default = no growth).
optimize_line_content_max_lines.title: Optimize Line Content Max Lines

enforce_cap_line.description: Clamp alphanumeric characters to the capline: when true (the default), every ASCII alphanumeric [0-9a-zA-Z] glyph whose ink extends above the per-font cap height is downscaled top-down (a vertical downscale about the glyph's own bottom, X untouched -- the aspect ratio changes) so its top lands exactly on the capline. The enforcement is strictly pre-markup: it applies before the small-caps, bold, scale, italic and superscript/subscript transforms. Non-alphanumeric characters (punctuation, spaces, derived Unicode symbols) are never clamped. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
enforce_cap_line.title: Enforce Cap Line

text_color.description: Stroke-color layer tag splitting otherwise-identical text into separate toolpaths (labels and text lines only; rejected at the job level; never cascades). Full name or case-insensitive single-letter abbreviation (c, m, y, k, r, g, b, v, o, p, t); 'none' is the implicit default and cannot be specified. The inline <tc:color>...</tc> markup applies the same split to the wrapped segment, overriding this field per character.

bullet_string.description: Character(s) used for each bullet of an itemize list. Cascades item -> itemize block -> label -> job (fallback '•' -- the derived bullet glyph, engraved by every PLT catalog font except the symbol fonts); an explicit empty string '' engraves no marker (an indent-only list). Settable on a list item to override one bullet.
bullet_string.title: Bullet String

counter_start_index.description: Starting number for an enumerate list (the first item's counter). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback 1).
counter_start_index.title: Counter Start Index

counter_style.description: Style of an enumerate list's counters: 'decimal' (1, 2, 3), 'lower-alpha' (a, b, ..., z, aa), 'upper-alpha' (A, B, ...), 'lower-roman' (i, ii, iii) or 'upper-roman' (I, II, III). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback 'decimal').

counter_prefix.description: String prepended to each enumerate counter (e.g. 'Step ' for 'Step 1', 'Step 2'). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback '' = no prefix).
counter_prefix.title: Counter Prefix

counter_suffix.description: String appended to each enumerate counter (e.g. '.' for '1.', ')' for '1)'). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback '' = no suffix).
counter_suffix.title: Counter Suffix

list_marker_gap_fraction.description: Air gap between a list item's marker (bullet or counter) and its text, as a unitless fraction of the line's rendered cap height, so it scales with the text size. The marker column is the widest marker of the list plus this gap, and every item's text (and every continuation line) starts at that column -- the hanging indent. Cascades item -> list block -> label -> job (fallback 0.5); explicit 0.0 is honored (marker flush against the text).
list_marker_gap_fraction.title: List Marker Gap Fraction

width.description: Label width in inches (must be > 0). Cascades label -> job; must be defined at one level.
width.title: Width

height.description: Label height in inches (must be > 0). Cascades label -> job; must be defined at one level.
height.title: Height

type.description: Label boundary shape: 'rect' (default, historical) or 'round' (ellipse with semi-axes width/2 and height/2; a circle when width == height). Cascades label -> job; unset (null) falls back to 'rect'. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.

rounded_rectangle_fraction.description: Corner rounding fraction in [0.0, 1.0] of the rectangular border (0.0 = sharp rectangle, the default). Corners are superellipse-quadrant patches with exponent 2/fraction, so curvature varies continuously along the boundary (no circular-fillet curvature jump). The rounding spans 'fraction' of the shorter edge: a 4x8 label at 0.5 rounds 2in (50%) of the 4in sides, starting 1in from each corner. At 1.0 with rounded_rectangle_proportional true (or on a square) the boundary is the exact ellipse/circle of type: round; on a non-square at 1.0 with proportional false the short edges fully round and the long edges keep straights. Cascades job -> plate -> label; unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then 0.0. Accepted on plates for schema parity only. Inert on type: round labels.
rounded_rectangle_fraction.title: Rounded Rectangle Fraction

rounded_rectangle_proportional.description: Whether rounded_rectangle_fraction applies proportionately to width and height (true: corner semi-axes fraction*width/2 and fraction*height/2) or as one identical rounding distance on every side (false, the default: the shorter edge determines the rounding for all sides). Cascades job -> plate -> label; unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then false. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
rounded_rectangle_proportional.title: Rounded Rectangle Proportional

margin.description: Universal margin in inches (fallback for h_margin and v_margin); cascades label -> job (fallback 0.125).
margin.title: Margin

h_margin.description: Horizontal margin in inches (left and right edges); cascades label -> job; falls back to margin if unset.
h_margin.title: H Margin

v_margin.description: Vertical margin in inches (top and bottom edges); cascades label -> job; falls back to margin if unset.
v_margin.title: V Margin

hole_margin.description: Distance from hole edge to label edge in inches (label -> job, fallback 0.1875).
hole_margin.title: Hole Margin

holes.description: Drill holes; a label value replaces the job-level list entirely (an empty list suppresses holes). 'corners'/'sides' expand to members.
holes.title: Holes

material.description: Stock material name (free-form, e.g. 'wb' or 'wb(uv)'); cascades job -> label. Labels sharing a material pack together and a plate never mixes materials. Comparison trims whitespace and ignores case; unset (null) labels pack with the job-level material.
material.title: Material

use_baseline_spacing.description: Stack a label's text lines by baseline-to-baseline pitch (text_height + line_spacing) so descenders hang into the gap and every gap reads as one uniform visual spacing; false stacks by rendered ink box (historical). Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then true. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
use_baseline_spacing.title: Use Baseline Spacing

v_center_by_content.description: Center a label's text block by its rendered ink (true, historical -- the deepest descender is charged to the block, so lines with descenders ride high) or by its baseline-to-capline band (false, the default -- the visible text is optically centered and descenders hang into the bottom margin for the descending-character relief to handle). Band centering is active only when auto_descending_character_adjustment is enabled; with the relief off, ink centering is kept and this field is inert. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then false. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
v_center_by_content.title: V Center By Content

auto_descending_character_adjustment.description: Automatically downscale and raise a descending glyph that comes (close to) colliding with a glyph on the following line. Per-descending-character, triggered by a measured near-miss against the line below -- never a blanket adjustment. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then true. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
auto_descending_character_adjustment.title: Auto Descending Character Adjustment

descending_character_v_scale.description: Maximum vertical downscale allowed for a triggering descending glyph in [0.2, 1.0] (1.0 = no downscaling, 0.5 = 50% downscaling), about the glyph's own baseline. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then 0.5. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
descending_character_v_scale.title: Descending Character V Scale

descending_character_raise.description: Maximum vertical raise allowed for a triggering descending glyph as a fraction of its own descender depth in [0.0, 1.0] (0.0 = no raising, 1.0 = lift until the glyph's lowest point sits exactly at the baseline). Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then 0.7. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
descending_character_raise.title: Descending Character Raise

descending_character_clearance.description: Extra air demanded between the engraved stroke of a descending glyph and the engraved stroke of a glyph on the following line, as a unitless factor of the stroke floor (required gap = floor * (1 + clearance)), so it scales with the cutter width and reads the same at every text size. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); explicit 0.0 is honored (only true touching triggers); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then 0.0. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
descending_character_clearance.title: Descending Character Clearance

descending_character_reciprocal_scale.description: Maximum vertical downscale allowed for the would-be-colliding glyphs on the FOLLOWING line in [0.2, 1.0] (1.0 = no reciprocal downscaling, 0.5 = 50% downscaling). The lower glyphs are scaled top-down about their own lowest ink point, so their lowest point never moves; they share the relief with the descending glyph in proportion to the same ramp driving its downscale/raise. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then 0.5. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
descending_character_reciprocal_scale.title: Descending Character Reciprocal Scale

adjust_h_center_for_single_side_hole.description: Permission to apply horizontal shift for asymmetric left/right drill holes. When enabled (true), text is horizontally shifted to center between left and right holes: shift = (left_diameter - right_diameter) / 2. Only applied to center-aligned text; left/right alignment ignores the shift. Vertical shifts (for top/bottom holes) are always applied and are not gated by this field. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then false. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
adjust_h_center_for_single_side_hole.title: Adjust H Center For Single Side Hole

hole_adjust_for_cutter.description: Shrink the emitted drill-hole circle by the boundary/hole cutter diameter (the cutter radius on each side of the hole's path) so the engraved hole measures the specified diameter: a 0.1in hole cut by a 0.015in cutter emits a 0.085in circle. The hole centre is untouched (placed from the specified diameter); a hole at or below the cutter diameter clamps to the smallest emittable circle with a WARNING. Cascades job -> plate -> label (never text lines); unset (null) falls back to job-config.json then true. Accepted on plates for schema parity only.
hole_adjust_for_cutter.title: Hole Adjust For Cutter

id.description: Unique identifier for this label specification.
id.title: Id

count.description: Number of instances to produce (must be >= 1).
count.title: Count

content.description: Content entries to render: plain text lines and nested itemize/enumerate list blocks. Required unless replacement_text_file is provided.
content.title: Content

replacement_text_file.description: Path to an EngraveLab/Vision Pro-style replacement text file. Each line produces one label instance. Mutually exclusive with count.
replacement_text_file.title: Replacement Text File

replacement_text_delimiter.description: Single-character delimiter separating text items within a replacement file line (default ';').
replacement_text_delimiter.title: Replacement Text Delimiter

plate_id.description: Id of the plate this label is pinned to (packs exclusively onto that plate). Set by plate-level replacement expansion.
plate_id.title: Plate Id

LabelSpec.title: LabelSpec

LayoutMode.description:
Enumeration of plate fill-order preferences for bin packing.

``rectpack`` has no sort option that controls fill order directly (the
emergent order is a side effect of placement tie-breaking), so
``columns`` is realized by packing in a transposed frame with a
bottom-row fill algorithm and mapping every placement back into plate
space (see ``plt_optimizer.generate.packing.layout``).

Attributes:
    ROWS: Fill the plate width first, then extend downward (row-major;
        the historical packing behaviour).
    COLUMNS: Fill the plate height first, then extend rightward
        (column-major; the default).
LayoutMode.title: LayoutMode

PlateSpec.description:
Specification for a plate (material sheet) to cut labels from.

Attributes:
    id: Unique identifier for this plate specification.
    width: Usable width of the plate in inches (the area available to
        the packer). The material's right edge sits at
        ``left_clearance + width``.
    height: Usable height of the plate in inches (the area available to
        the packer). The material's bottom edge sits at
        ``top_clearance + height``.
    left_clearance: Unused material width along the plate's left edge
        in inches; shifts the usable area rightward. Defaults to 0.0.
        Bottom and right clearances need no fields: the material always
        extends to ``left_clearance + width`` on the right and
        ``top_clearance + height`` at the bottom.
    top_clearance: Unused material height along the plate's top edge in
        inches; shifts the usable area downward (labels stay flush with
        the bottom edge). Defaults to 0.0.
    h_margin: Optional horizontal margin in inches. Accepted for schema
        parity with the job/label ``h_margin`` cascade. NOTE: labels
        are rendered once and cached before bin-packing (and a single
        label may span multiple plates), so a per-plate value is not
        currently applied during rendering; the effective value is
        resolved from the label -> job -> default cascade.
    v_margin: Optional vertical margin in inches. Accepted for schema
        parity with the job/label ``v_margin`` cascade. NOTE: labels
        are rendered once and cached before bin-packing (and a single
        label may span multiple plates), so a per-plate value is not
        currently applied during rendering; the effective value is
        resolved from the label -> job -> default cascade.
    hole_margin: Optional hole margin in inches. Accepted for schema
        parity with the job/label ``hole_margin`` cascade. NOTE: labels
        are rendered once and cached before bin-packing (and a single
        label may span multiple plates), so a per-plate value is not
        currently applied during rendering; the effective value is
        resolved from the label -> job -> default cascade.
    max_h_compress: Optional maximum horizontal compression fraction.
        Accepted for schema parity with the job/label ``max_h_compress``
        cascade. NOTE: labels are rendered once and cached before
        bin-packing (and a single label may span multiple plates), so a
        per-plate value is not currently applied during rendering; the
        effective value is resolved from the label -> job -> default
        cascade.
    text_h_alignment: Optional horizontal text alignment. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label ``text_h_alignment`` cascade.
        NOTE: labels are rendered once and cached before bin-packing
        (and a single label may span multiple plates), so a per-plate
        value is not currently applied during rendering; the effective
        value is resolved from the label -> job -> default cascade.
    type: Optional label boundary shape (``rect`` / ``round``). Accepted
        for schema parity with the label ``type`` cascade. NOTE: label
        shape is a per-label property resolved before packing; a
        per-plate value is not applied (parity only).
    rounded_rectangle_fraction: Optional corner rounding fraction in
        ``[0.0, 1.0]`` for rectangular borders. Accepted for schema parity
        with the label ``rounded_rectangle_fraction`` cascade. NOTE: the
        border is a per-label property resolved before packing; a
        per-plate value is not applied (parity only).
    rounded_rectangle_proportional: Optional proportional-rounding flag.
        Accepted for schema parity with the label
        ``rounded_rectangle_proportional`` cascade. NOTE: a per-plate
        value is not applied (parity only).
    min_hole_margin: Optional minimum hole margin in inches. Accepted
        for schema parity with the job/label ``min_hole_margin``
        cascade. NOTE: labels are rendered once and cached before
        bin-packing (and a single label may span multiple plates), so
        a per-plate value is not currently applied during rendering;
        the effective value is resolved from the label -> job ->
        default cascade.
    hole_text_collision_distance: Optional minimum engraved-stroke
        air gap in inches. Accepted for schema parity with the
        job/label ``hole_text_collision_distance`` cascade. NOTE:
        labels are rendered once and cached before bin-packing, so a
        per-plate value is not currently applied during rendering;
        the effective value is resolved from the label -> job ->
        default cascade.
    space_width_fraction: Optional space advance fraction. Accepted
        for schema parity with the job/label ``space_width_fraction``
        cascade. NOTE: labels are rendered once and cached before
        bin-packing, so a per-plate value is not currently applied
        during rendering; the effective value is resolved from the
        line -> label -> job -> default cascade.
    min_glyph_width_fraction: Optional global minimum glyph advance
        width as a fraction of the rendered cap height. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label
        ``min_glyph_width_fraction`` cascade. NOTE: labels are rendered
        once and cached before bin-packing, so a per-plate value is not
        currently applied during rendering; the effective value is
        resolved from the line -> label -> job -> default cascade.
    kerning_window_fraction: Optional kerning window fraction in
        ``[0.0, 1.0]``. Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``kerning_window_fraction`` cascade. NOTE: labels are rendered
        once and cached before bin-packing, so a per-plate value is
        not currently applied during rendering; the effective value is
        resolved from the line -> label -> job -> default cascade.
    kerning_penetration_scale: Optional penetration multiplier.
        Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``kerning_penetration_scale`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    kerning_recession_scale: Optional recession multiplier. Accepted
        for schema parity with the job/label
        ``kerning_recession_scale`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    kerning_min_gap_fraction: Optional extra kerning air as a fraction
        of the rendered cap height. Accepted
        for schema parity with the job/label ``kerning_min_gap_fraction``
        cascade (not applied at plate level).
    fallback_advance_fraction: Optional fallback-advance multiplier.
        Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``fallback_advance_fraction`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    sc_scale: Optional small-caps downscale for ASCII lowercase ``a-z``
        (a ``font`` name ending in `` SC``). Accepted for schema parity
        with the job/label ``sc_scale`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    supersubscript_downscale: Optional bare ``<sup>``/``<sub>`` run
        downscale. Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``supersubscript_downscale`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    html_brackets: Optional inline-markup delimiter pair. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label ``html_brackets`` cascade (not
        applied at plate level).
    italic_angle: Optional italic slant angle in degrees. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label ``italic_angle`` cascade (not
        applied at plate level).
    underline_offset_fraction: Optional underline air as a fraction of
        the rendered cap height. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label ``underline_offset_fraction``
        cascade (not applied at plate level).
    underline_break_clearance_fraction: Optional air at each underline
        break as a fraction of the rendered cap height. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label
        ``underline_break_clearance_fraction`` cascade (not applied at
        plate level).
    underline_break_spaces: Optional break-at-spaces flag. Accepted for
        schema parity with the job/label ``underline_break_spaces``
        cascade (not applied at plate level).
    strikethrough_offset_fraction: Optional strikethrough height as a
        fraction of the rendered cap height, above
        the baseline. Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``strikethrough_offset_fraction`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    strikethrough_break_spaces: Optional break-at-spaces flag. Accepted
        for schema parity with the job/label
        ``strikethrough_break_spaces`` cascade (not applied at plate
        level).
    cutter_size: Optional cutter diameter in inches. Accepted for schema
        parity with the job/label ``cutter_size`` cascade (not applied at
        plate level).
    cutter_downsize: Optional compression-driven cutter reduction flag.
        Accepted for schema parity with the job/label ``cutter_downsize``
        cascade (not applied at plate level).
    max_cutter_downsizes: Optional cap on cutter downsizing steps.
        Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``max_cutter_downsizes`` cascade (not applied at plate level).
    optimize_line_content: Optional word-level line-content reflow
        permission. Accepted for schema parity with the job/label
        ``optimize_line_content`` cascade (not applied at plate level).
    optimize_line_content_max_lines: Optional ceiling on the number of
        consecutive lines a reflow group may use. Accepted for schema
        parity with the job/label ``optimize_line_content_max_lines``
        cascade (not applied at plate level).
    auto_descending_character_adjustment: Optional automatic
        descending-character relief permission. Accepted for schema parity
        with the job/label ``auto_descending_character_adjustment``
        cascade (not applied at plate level -- labels render before

TextColor.description:
Enumeration of stroke-color layer tags for text lines and labels.

The color carries no visual meaning in the emitted PLT: it is a layer
tag that splits otherwise-identical text into separate toolpaths (one
HPGL ``SP`` layer and one PLT file per color), so the cutter depth can
be changed between runs to expose a different material layer color on
3-layer stock. This mirrors the EngraveLab/Vision Pro workflow where a
different stroke color forces a separate toolpath.

Values may be written as the full name (``cyan``) or as the
single-letter abbreviation (``c``); both forms are case-insensitive.
The inline ``<tc:color>...</tc>`` markup accepts exactly the same
values and applies the split per character (the tag wins over the
``text_color`` field inside its span; see
``plt_optimizer/generate/markup/AGENTS.md``).
``none`` is the implicit default for every line that does not declare
a color and must never be specified explicitly (see the ``text_color``
field validator): users pick a real color name to force a toolpath
split.

Attributes:
    cyan: Cyan stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``c``).
    magenta: Magenta stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``m``).
    yellow: Yellow stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``y``).
    black: Black stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``k``, CMYK style).
    red: Red stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``r``).
    green: Green stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``g``).
    blue: Blue stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``b``).
    violet: Violet stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``v``).
    orange: Orange stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``o``).
    pink: Pink stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``p``).
    teal: Teal stroke-color layer (abbreviation ``t``).
    none: Implicit default for text that declares no color; cannot be
        specified explicitly.
TextColor.title: TextColor

TextHAlignment.description:
Enumeration of valid horizontal text alignment modes for a text line.

The alignment anchors the rendered line within the label's inner content
area (label width minus both margins). ``left`` places the line's
left-most point precisely at the left margin; ``right`` places the
line's right-most point precisely at the right margin; ``center``
(the default) centers the line horizontally.

Attributes:
    LEFT: Left edge of the line sits at the left margin.
    CENTER: Line is horizontally centered within the inner content area.
    RIGHT: Right edge of the line sits at the right margin.
TextHAlignment.title: TextHAlignment

TextLine.description:
A single line of text content within a label.

Attributes:
    text: The actual text string to render.
    text_height: Optional font height in inches. Inherits from parent
        LabelSpec.text_height or JobSpec.text_height if not set locally.
    placeholder: When ``True``, this line is replaced by the corresponding
        item from the replacement file during expansion; all other
        attributes (text height, alignment, color, ...) are preserved on
        the synthesized line. Non-placeholder lines are copied verbatim to
        every generated label instance. Requires the parent label to
        declare ``replacement_text_file``.
    new_line: When ``True``, this line begins on its own line in the
        label. It modifies the word-level line-content reflow
        (``optimize_line_content``): the line starts a new reflow group,
        so the lines that follow it (which do not carry the flag
        themselves) reflow together with it instead of with the lines
        above it. The flag is inert when the line does not enable
        ``optimize_line_content`` (every line then begins on its own line
        already). Line-level only -- it is never inherited from the label
        or the job, and it has no ``job-config.json`` counterpart.

Appending ' SC' to any name selects its synthetic small-caps variant (uppercase glyphs verbatim, ASCII lowercase a-z downscaled by sc_scale). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback ReliefSingleLineCAD-Regular). Unknown names are rejected; run docs/schema/generate_schema_docs.py --show-fonts for the full valid list. The inline <f:font name>...</f> markup tag selects any of these names for the wrapped characters of a text line (the run engraves with the cutter its own font's ladder gives that text height); '+' is the canonical space in the tag argument (e.g. <f:Dino+SC>).

hole_text_collision_distance.title: Hole Text Collision Distance

space_width_fraction.description: Space advance as a fraction of the rendered text height (PLT-extracted fonts): a space advances space_width_fraction * text_height + character_spacing. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.3); explicit 0.0 is honored.
space_width_fraction.title: Space Width Fraction

min_glyph_width_fraction.description: Global minimum glyph advance width as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline) for PLT-extracted fonts: clamps the profile-envelope kerning so zero-width glyphs still reserve real air. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0 = pure envelope kerning); explicit 0.0 is honored.
min_glyph_width_fraction.title: Min Glyph Width Fraction

kerning_window_fraction.description: Kerning window for PLT-extracted fonts as a fraction of the rendered text height in [0.0, 1.0]: each envelope sample compares against the opposite silhouette within +/- (half of this fraction) of the text height and the effective penetration is the worst windowed penetration, so staggered pokes widen the advance. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.05); explicit 0.0 is honored (= historical same-height kerning).
kerning_window_fraction.title: Kerning Window Fraction

kerning_penetration_scale.description: Multiplier on the profile-envelope penetration detected for PLT-extracted fonts: 1.0 keeps the geometric penetration, >1.0 over-kerns tight pairs proportionally. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.0); explicit 0.0 is honored (ignores detected closeness entirely).
kerning_penetration_scale.title: Kerning Penetration Scale

kerning_recession_scale.description: Multiplier on a *recessed* (negative) profile-envelope penetration for PLT-extracted fonts: 1.0 keeps the geometric recession (the historical linear behaviour, where lowering kerning_penetration_scale also pulled gapped pairs closer), 0.0 makes a recessed pair advance by nothing beyond the min_glyph_width_fraction floor. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.0); explicit 0.0 is honored.
kerning_recession_scale.title: Kerning Recession Scale

kerning_min_gap_fraction.description: Extra air added to every kerned character pair advance (PLT-extracted fonts) as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline), on top of the cutter diameter and character_spacing clearance. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0 = no extra gap); explicit 0.0 is honored.
kerning_min_gap_fraction.title: Kerning Min Gap Fraction

fallback_advance_fraction.description: Multiplier on the bounding-box-width fallback advance used for PLT-extracted glyph pairs without overlapping height (or lacking envelopes). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.0 = the left glyph's own width); explicit 0.0 is honored.
fallback_advance_fraction.title: Fallback Advance Fraction

kern_pos_string.description: Manual-kern positive marker string: every occurrence in a text line is stripped (it never engraves) and replaced by a forward cursor shift of kern_width_fraction * cap height (capline - baseline) applied to the following character. Multi-character strings are legal (e.g. '<->'); the value must be non-empty, contain no newline, and differ from kern_neg_string. A marker that parses as inline markup under the line's effective html_brackets (e.g. '<s>' with the default brackets - the strikethrough tag consumes it before the kern strip) is rejected at resolution; '<->' is a legal marker. Unset (None) disables the positive marker. Cascades line -> label -> job (job-config.json supplies the shop default); works on PLT and TTF fonts.
kern_pos_string.title: Kern Pos String

kern_neg_string.description: Manual-kern negative marker string: every occurrence in a text line is stripped (it never engraves) and replaced by a backward cursor shift of kern_width_fraction * cap height (capline - baseline) applied to the following character (no clamp, so a large value lets glyphs overlap). Same validation as kern_pos_string; the two strings must differ. Unset (None) disables the negative marker. Cascades line -> label -> job (job-config.json supplies the shop default); works on PLT and TTF fonts.
kern_neg_string.title: Kern Neg String

kern_width_fraction.description: Manual-kern width as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): one kern_pos_string marker advances the cursor by +fraction * cap height, one kern_neg_string marker retreats it by -fraction * cap height (adjacent markers accumulate). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.1); explicit 0.0 is honored (markers consume their characters but shift nothing).
kern_width_fraction.title: Kern Width Fraction

sc_scale.description: Downscale applied to ASCII lowercase a-z by a small-caps font (a font name ending in ' SC', e.g. 'Dino SC'): the lowercase character renders as the base font's uppercase glyph uniformly shrunk to sc_scale of the cap height, top-down (the glyph's own bottom stays in place and its top descends). Uppercase and caseless characters engrave at full size; the nominal text_height is untouched (no cutter change). The same field drives the inline <sc> small-caps markup tag (the per-character selection); inert on a non-SC font carrying no <sc> run. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.7); explicit 0.2/1.0 are honored.
sc_scale.title: Sc Scale

supersubscript_downscale.description: Downscale applied to a bare <sup>/<sub> markup run: the run's glyphs engrave uniformly shrunk to this fraction of the line's size, and the baseline shift derives from it, centering the shrunken glyph on the line it belongs to (superscript rises 1 - d/2 cap heights, its centre landing on the capline; subscript drops d/2 cap heights, its centre landing on the baseline). The argumented forms <sup:0.3>/<sub:-0.2> set the shift explicitly (cap-height units) and apply no scaling, so this field is inert on them. The run engraves with the cutter for its downscaled height (the <scale:N> ladder). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.5); explicit 0.2/1.0 are honored.
supersubscript_downscale.title: Supersubscript Downscale

html_brackets.description: Delimiter pair for the inline markup syntax (<i> italic and future tags): an even-length string whose first half is the left delimiter and second half the right delimiter ('<>' -> '<' + '>', '<<>>' -> '<<' + '>>'). The halves must differ and contain no alphanumeric characters or newlines. A bracketed body that is not a registered tag engraves verbatim, so choosing a pair absent from the data keeps chevrons from being read as markup. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback '<>'); the slash is only special inside the delimiters.
html_brackets.title: Html Brackets

italic_angle.description: Slant angle in degrees for italic markup (<i>): PLT-extracted glyphs (and TTF glyphs with no native italic face) are sheared about the baseline, x' = x + y * tan(angle), so the baseline stays fixed and the glyph leans right. Bound to [0, 45]; 0 means upright (the shear is skipped). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 12); explicit 0.0/45.0 are honored.
italic_angle.title: Italic Angle

underline_offset_fraction.description: Extra air for underline markup (<u>) as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): the underline centerline (cut with the line's own text cutter) sits cutter diameter + fraction * cap height below the baseline, so the engraved underline's top edge floats exactly that air below the engraved baseline stroke. The break test is strictly horizontal: a glyph breaks the underline where its ink crosses the underline's centerline, so raising it lifts the underline clear and stops it breaking. 0.0 = the underline's top edge touches the baseline stroke. Must be >= 0. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0); explicit 0.0 is honored.
underline_offset_fraction.title: Underline Offset Fraction

underline_break_clearance_fraction.description: Extra air at each underline (<u>) break as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): each cut is padded horizontally by 0.5 * cutter + fraction * cap height (the half cutter is the glyph stroke's own half-width), so the engraved air between a descending glyph's stroke and the underline's cut edge is exactly this value. 0.0 = the cut sits at the ink. Independent of underline_offset_fraction (which decides which glyphs break). Must be >= 0. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0); explicit 0.0 is honored.
underline_break_clearance_fraction.title: Underline Break Clearance Fraction

underline_break_spaces.description: Break an underline (<u>) at the spaces between words: false (default) draws one continuous underline across the whole underlined run (spaces included, broken only by descending glyphs); true ends the underline at each space so every word gets its own underline and the inter-word space stays bare. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit false is honored.
underline_break_spaces.title: Underline Break Spaces

strikethrough_offset_fraction.description: Strikethrough (<s>) height ABOVE the baseline as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): the stroke (cut with the line's own text cutter) sits fraction * cap height above the baseline, so 0.0 puts it on the baseline and 1.0 puts it on the capline. Unlike the underline the stroke is never broken -- a descender punches through it. null (default) centres the stroke on the cap-band midline (half the rendered cap height). Must be >= 0. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback null = mid-cap); explicit 0.0 is honored.
strikethrough_offset_fraction.title: Strikethrough Offset Fraction

strikethrough_break_spaces.description: Break a strikethrough (<s>) at the spaces between words: false (default) draws one continuous stroke across the whole struck run (spaces included); true ends the stroke at each space so every word gets its own strike and the inter-word space stays bare. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit false is honored.
strikethrough_break_spaces.title: Strikethrough Break Spaces

v_center_chars.description: Character set auto-centred vertically between the baseline and the capline: every text character occurring in this string is raised or lowered (a pure vertical translate) so its own ink is centred on the cap-band midline (half the rendered cap height above the baseline) - the characters a font typically draws too high (hyphen, colon, en/em dash, '=', '<', '>'). The inline <vc>...</vc> markup tag applies the same centering to any other characters it wraps. Empty string '' disables the auto-apply (the <vc> tag keeps working on its own). Cascades line -> label -> job (code fallback '' = auto-apply off; job-config.json ships the shop set '-:–—=<>'); an explicit '' is honored.
v_center_chars.title: V Center Chars

cutter_size.description: Cutter diameter in inches to use for this text instead of the tool auto-selected from text_height. Snapped to the shop inventory (tools.json available_cutters: next size down, else next size up); the rendered toolpath height becomes text_height - cutter_size. Omit (null) to keep automatic cutter selection from text_height. Must be > 0 and below the line's text_height. No job-config.json counterpart. Cascades line -> label -> job.
cutter_size.title: Cutter Size

target_boldness_factor.description: Target engraved stroke width as a fraction of text height for multi-stroke (bold) PLT fonts - fonts whose glyphs carry N > 1 parallel cutter passes (the stroke_count stored in the font's catalog file). The automatic cutter is sized so the N passes plus their overlaps engrave this total width, with multistroke_overlap_ratio guarding against unengraved stripes; the resulting cutter is snapped to the shop inventory. The implicit pass overlap is derived and logged. Inert on single-stroke fonts, TTF fonts, and lines with an explicit cutter_size. Bound to [0.05, 0.30]. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.14); accepted on plates for schema parity only.
target_boldness_factor.title: Target Boldness Factor

multistroke_overlap_ratio.description: Minimum overlap fraction between adjacent cutter passes of a multi-stroke (bold) PLT font: the automatic cutter is never smaller than pass_spacing / (1 - this ratio), so adjacent engraved strokes always overlap by at least this fraction and no unengraved stripe can appear between passes (an overlap of 0.25 means the stepover stays within 75% of the cutter width). The actual overlap is derived from the chosen cutter and logged. Inert on single-stroke fonts, TTF fonts, and lines with an explicit cutter_size. Bound to [0.1, 0.5]. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.25); accepted on plates for schema parity only.
multistroke_overlap_ratio.title: Multistroke Overlap Ratio

bold_boldness_multiplier.description: Boldness boost applied by inline <b> markup to a multi-stroke (bold) PLT font: the bold runs re-run the cutter ladder at target_boldness_factor * this multiplier (clamped to 0.30 with a WARNING), so their parallel passes engrave heavier than the line's plain text. On single-stroke PLT and TTF fonts <b> instead steps to the next larger inventory cutter and this multiplier is inert. Bound to [1.0, 4.0]; 1.0 disables the boost. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.5); accepted on plates for schema parity only.
bold_boldness_multiplier.title: Bold Boldness Multiplier

cutter_downsize.description: Allow the automatically selected cutter to be reduced when the text line is horizontally compressed: a line squeezed past the midpoint toward the next smaller inventory tool swaps to it and re-renders at text_height - smaller_cutter. One-way (a downsized cutter is never enlarged again within the same line) and fully overridden by an explicit cutter_size. Requires a tools.json available_cutters inventory. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
cutter_downsize.title: Cutter Downsize

max_cutter_downsizes.description: Maximum number of successive cutter downsizings applied to one text line (0 disables the mechanism, 1 = at most one size down). Each step re-measures the line, since a smaller cutter renders wider. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1); explicit 0 is honored.
max_cutter_downsizes.title: Max Cutter Downsizes

cutter_downsize_global.description: Share a compression-driven cutter downsize across the text lines of one label: when a line's compression triggers a swap to a smaller inventory tool, every other eligible line of the same text_height in the same label receives the same swap (then each continues its own one-way step loop). Lines with an explicit cutter_size, cutter_downsize false, max_cutter_downsizes 0, or a zero max_h_compress budget are never touched. Setting the option at the job level enables it for every label; sharing is always per-label. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
cutter_downsize_global.title: Cutter Downsize Global

cutter_downsize_global_job_wide.description: Widen the scope of the shared cutter downsize from the label to the whole job: when a line's compression triggers a swap, every eligible line of the same text_height in ANY label of the job receives the same swap (the job converges on one tool per text size). Requires cutter_downsize_global true; a line with this flag false keeps exactly the per-label behaviour (it neither shares to nor receives from the job-wide group). The same eligibility opt-outs apply. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit true is honored.
cutter_downsize_global_job_wide.title: Cutter Downsize Global Job Wide

h_compress_global.description: Share horizontal compression across the text lines of one label: when a line's width forces horizontal compression, every other eligible line of the same text_height in the same label is compressed to the same scale (the most-compressed scale among the triggering lines, clamped to each line's own max_h_compress budget floor). Lines with a zero max_h_compress budget are never touched. Setting the option at the job level enables it for every label; sharing is always per-label. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit true is honored.
h_compress_global.title: H Compress Global

h_compress_global_same_height_only.description: The grouping scope of the shared horizontal compression: true (the default) shares the compression only between the lines of the same text_height in the label (one text size, one glyph density); false shares it across EVERY eligible line of the label, whatever their text_height, so one label engraves at one glyph density throughout. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
h_compress_global_same_height_only.title: H Compress Global Same Height Only

arc_preserve_compression.description: Keep PLT-font glyphs arc-native through the non-uniform text transforms (horizontal compression, the cap-line clamp, the descender relief and the italic shear): each arc's ellipse image is refit with a short chain of circular AA arcs (bounded deviation, see plt_optimizer/generate/arc_fit.py) instead of polygonizing into line segments, so a compressed line engraves far faster. True (the default) preserves arcs; false restores the historical polygonized output. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
arc_preserve_compression.title: Arc Preserve Compression

optimize_line_content.description: Redistribute this line's words across the consecutive lines that also enable the option: whole words move between the enabled lines of the group (word order is never changed, only the line breaks) so the group's lines reach equal rendered width, minimizing the horizontal compression the label would otherwise need. Consecutive enabled lines form one independent group; a disabled line breaks the group. Runs as an export pre-pass before the cutter-reduction and shared-compression pre-passes. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit true is honored.
optimize_line_content.title: Optimize Line Content

optimize_line_content_max_lines.description: Ceiling N on how many consecutive lines an optimize_line_content group may use. This option can only ever ADD lines to a label; it never removes, blanks or collapses one. Unset reflows across the group's existing lines and adds none. When set, the reflow starts at the group's existing line count G and grows the group (inserting lines cloned from the group's typography) until its lines need no horizontal compression, M reaches N, or M reaches the group's word count. N <= G leaves the cap inert. Setting it on any one line of a group applies it to the whole group; two different values in one group are an error, and so is specifying it while optimize_line_content is not enabled. Cascades line -> label -> job (unset by default = no growth).
optimize_line_content_max_lines.title: Optimize Line Content Max Lines

enforce_cap_line.description: Clamp alphanumeric characters to the capline: when true (the default), every ASCII alphanumeric [0-9a-zA-Z] glyph whose ink extends above the per-font cap height is downscaled top-down (a vertical downscale about the glyph's own bottom, X untouched -- the aspect ratio changes) so its top lands exactly on the capline. The enforcement is strictly pre-markup: it applies before the small-caps, bold, scale, italic and superscript/subscript transforms. Non-alphanumeric characters (punctuation, spaces, derived Unicode symbols) are never clamped. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback true); explicit false is honored.
enforce_cap_line.title: Enforce Cap Line

text_color.description: Stroke-color layer tag splitting otherwise-identical text into separate toolpaths (labels and text lines only; rejected at the job level; never cascades). Full name or case-insensitive single-letter abbreviation (c, m, y, k, r, g, b, v, o, p, t); 'none' is the implicit default and cannot be specified. The inline <tc:color>...</tc> markup applies the same split to the wrapped segment, overriding this field per character.

bullet_string.description: Character(s) used for each bullet of an itemize list. Cascades item -> itemize block -> label -> job (fallback '•' -- the derived bullet glyph, engraved by every PLT catalog font except the symbol fonts); an explicit empty string '' engraves no marker (an indent-only list). Settable on a list item to override one bullet.
bullet_string.title: Bullet String

counter_start_index.description: Starting number for an enumerate list (the first item's counter). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback 1).
counter_start_index.title: Counter Start Index

counter_style.description: Style of an enumerate list's counters: 'decimal' (1, 2, 3), 'lower-alpha' (a, b, ..., z, aa), 'upper-alpha' (A, B, ...), 'lower-roman' (i, ii, iii) or 'upper-roman' (I, II, III). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback 'decimal').

counter_prefix.description: String prepended to each enumerate counter (e.g. 'Step ' for 'Step 1', 'Step 2'). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback '' = no prefix).
counter_prefix.title: Counter Prefix

counter_suffix.description: String appended to each enumerate counter (e.g. '.' for '1.', ')' for '1)'). Cascades item -> enumerate block -> label -> job (fallback '' = no suffix).
counter_suffix.title: Counter Suffix

list_marker_gap_fraction.description: Air gap between a list item's marker (bullet or counter) and its text, as a unitless fraction of the line's rendered cap height, so it scales with the text size. The marker column is the widest marker of the list plus this gap, and every item's text (and every continuation line) starts at that column -- the hanging indent. Cascades item -> list block -> label -> job (fallback 0.5); explicit 0.0 is honored (marker flush against the text).
list_marker_gap_fraction.title: List Marker Gap Fraction

placeholder.description: Mark this line for selective replacement. When True, the line's text is replaced by the corresponding replacement-file item; its other attributes are preserved. Non-placeholder lines copy verbatim to every instance. Requires the parent label to declare replacement_text_file.
placeholder.title: Placeholder

new_line.description: Force this line to begin on its own line. When True, the line starts a new optimize_line_content reflow group: the lines that follow it reflow with it rather than with the lines above it, so the group's words fill the lines from this one downward. The flag has no effect unless this line also enables optimize_line_content. Line-level only: it is not inherited from the label or the job, and job-config.json has no counterpart.
new_line.title: New Line

TextLine.title: TextLine

description:
Top-level specification for a batch label generation job.

Inherits styling fields from LabelAttributes so they can be set at the
job level and inherited down to labels and text lines. ``width`` and
``height`` must be defined at either the job level or on each label.

A job may be specified in one of three forms:
1. A list of explicit labels (`labels`), each with width/height defined.
2. A single root-level label definition (`content` + optional `count`),
   with width/height defined at the job or root level.
3. A job-level EngraveLab/Vision Pro-style replacement text file
   (``replacement_text_file``): each line of the file produces one
   label, generated from the job-level label attributes. ``width``,
   ``height`` and ``text_height`` must be defined at the job level;
   ``content`` is an optional per-line attribute template (exactly
   like on :class:`LabelSpec`). This form is mutually exclusive with
   ``labels`` and ``count``.

The label source forms (1-3) are mutually exclusive; exactly one must
be provided. The ``width`` and ``height`` cascade from label to job;
they are no longer auto-sized from rendered content.

Attributes:
    job_name: Human-readable name for this job.
    plates: Optional list of plate specifications. If omitted, the
        generation pipeline auto-allocates default 24x16 sheets.
    labels: Optional list of unique label specifications to produce.
    count: Optional count for root-level single-label jobs.
    content: Optional root-level content for single-label jobs (or the
        per-line attribute template for a job-level replacement file).
    replacement_text_file: Job-level replacement text file (resolved
        relative to the job YAML directory unless absolute). Each line
        produces one label; items within a line are separated by
        ``replacement_text_delimiter``. Requires job-level ``width``,
        ``height`` and ``text_height``; mutually exclusive with
        ``labels``, ``count`` and plate-level replacement files.
    replacement_text_delimiter: Single special or whitespace character
        separating text items within a replacement file line. Defaults
        to ``";"``. Requires ``replacement_text_file``.
    allow_rotation: Whether the bin packer may rotate label instances
        90 degrees to improve plate utilization. When a rotated label
        is assembled onto a plate its whole content (text, border and
        drill holes) is rotated clockwise. Defaults to True.
    text_chunk_mode: Granularity at which rendered text becomes a
        plate-space optimization node: ``"line"`` (the default) routes
        each whole text line as one unit; ``"word"`` splits lines on
        whitespace for finer rapid-travel routing at the cost of more
        TSP nodes.
    layout: Preferential plate fill order for bin packing. ``columns``
        (the default) fills each plate's height before extending
        rightward; ``rows`` fills width before extending downward (the
        historical behaviour). Cascades job -> plate: a plate may
        override it via ``PlateSpec.layout``.
    left_clearance: Job-level default for the plate left-edge
        clearance in inches. Cascades job -> plate: plates that omit
        ``left_clearance`` inherit this value; an explicit plate
        value (including ``0.0``) always wins. Unbounded
        auto-allocated sheets use it too (threaded through the export
        call). ``None`` (the default) means no job-level default;
        plates then fall back to their own ``0.0`` default.
    top_clearance: Job-level default for the plate top-edge clearance
        in inches (same cascade as ``left_clearance``).

text_height.description: Font height in inches. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.25).
text_height.title: Text Height

font.description: Font name: a PLT-extracted font key (the font_name fields of fonts/VP-EL-fonts/catalog/*.json, rendered arc-native with arcs preserved) or a TrueType basename (*.ttf under fonts/, extension stripped); case-insensitive, canonicalized at validation. Appending ' SC' to any name selects its synthetic small-caps variant (uppercase glyphs verbatim, ASCII lowercase a-z downscaled by sc_scale). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback ReliefSingleLineCAD-Regular). Unknown names are rejected; run docs/schema/generate_schema_docs.py --show-fonts for the full valid list. The inline <f:font name>...</f> markup tag selects any of these names for the wrapped characters of a text line (the run engraves with the cutter its own font's ladder gives that text height); '+' is the canonical space in the tag argument (e.g. <f:Dino+SC>).
font.title: Font

character_spacing.description: Extra spacing between characters in inches (fallback: 1.5x the resolved cutter diameter).
character_spacing.title: Character Spacing

line_spacing.description: Extra spacing between text lines in inches, or 'auto' to calculate spacing automatically based on label height, margins, and text line count (default when unspecified). Fallback when not specified at any level is 'auto'.
line_spacing.title: Line Spacing

text_h_alignment.description: Horizontal text alignment: left, center, or right.

min_hole_margin.description: Minimum hole margin in inches; hole margins will not shrink below this value during collision avoidance.
min_hole_margin.title: Min Hole Margin

hole_text_collision_distance.description: Minimum air gap in inches between engraved text and drill hole strokes, on top of the stroke floor 0.5 * (hole_cutter + text_cutter).
hole_text_collision_distance.title: Hole Text Collision Distance

space_width_fraction.description: Space advance as a fraction of the rendered text height (PLT-extracted fonts): a space advances space_width_fraction * text_height + character_spacing. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.3); explicit 0.0 is honored.
space_width_fraction.title: Space Width Fraction

min_glyph_width_fraction.description: Global minimum glyph advance width as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline) for PLT-extracted fonts: clamps the profile-envelope kerning so zero-width glyphs still reserve real air. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0 = pure envelope kerning); explicit 0.0 is honored.
min_glyph_width_fraction.title: Min Glyph Width Fraction

kerning_window_fraction.description: Kerning window for PLT-extracted fonts as a fraction of the rendered text height in [0.0, 1.0]: each envelope sample compares against the opposite silhouette within +/- (half of this fraction) of the text height and the effective penetration is the worst windowed penetration, so staggered pokes widen the advance. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.05); explicit 0.0 is honored (= historical same-height kerning).
kerning_window_fraction.title: Kerning Window Fraction

kerning_penetration_scale.description: Multiplier on the profile-envelope penetration detected for PLT-extracted fonts: 1.0 keeps the geometric penetration, >1.0 over-kerns tight pairs proportionally. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.0); explicit 0.0 is honored (ignores detected closeness entirely).
kerning_penetration_scale.title: Kerning Penetration Scale

kerning_recession_scale.description: Multiplier on a *recessed* (negative) profile-envelope penetration for PLT-extracted fonts: 1.0 keeps the geometric recession (the historical linear behaviour, where lowering kerning_penetration_scale also pulled gapped pairs closer), 0.0 makes a recessed pair advance by nothing beyond the min_glyph_width_fraction floor. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.0); explicit 0.0 is honored.
kerning_recession_scale.title: Kerning Recession Scale

kerning_min_gap_fraction.description: Extra air added to every kerned character pair advance (PLT-extracted fonts) as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline), on top of the cutter diameter and character_spacing clearance. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0 = no extra gap); explicit 0.0 is honored.
kerning_min_gap_fraction.title: Kerning Min Gap Fraction

fallback_advance_fraction.description: Multiplier on the bounding-box-width fallback advance used for PLT-extracted glyph pairs without overlapping height (or lacking envelopes). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 1.0 = the left glyph's own width); explicit 0.0 is honored.
fallback_advance_fraction.title: Fallback Advance Fraction

kern_pos_string.description: Manual-kern positive marker string: every occurrence in a text line is stripped (it never engraves) and replaced by a forward cursor shift of kern_width_fraction * cap height (capline - baseline) applied to the following character. Multi-character strings are legal (e.g. '<->'); the value must be non-empty, contain no newline, and differ from kern_neg_string. A marker that parses as inline markup under the line's effective html_brackets (e.g. '<s>' with the default brackets - the strikethrough tag consumes it before the kern strip) is rejected at resolution; '<->' is a legal marker. Unset (None) disables the positive marker. Cascades line -> label -> job (job-config.json supplies the shop default); works on PLT and TTF fonts.
kern_pos_string.title: Kern Pos String

kern_neg_string.description: Manual-kern negative marker string: every occurrence in a text line is stripped (it never engraves) and replaced by a backward cursor shift of kern_width_fraction * cap height (capline - baseline) applied to the following character (no clamp, so a large value lets glyphs overlap). Same validation as kern_pos_string; the two strings must differ. Unset (None) disables the negative marker. Cascades line -> label -> job (job-config.json supplies the shop default); works on PLT and TTF fonts.
kern_neg_string.title: Kern Neg String

kern_width_fraction.description: Manual-kern width as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): one kern_pos_string marker advances the cursor by +fraction * cap height, one kern_neg_string marker retreats it by -fraction * cap height (adjacent markers accumulate). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.1); explicit 0.0 is honored (markers consume their characters but shift nothing).
kern_width_fraction.title: Kern Width Fraction

sc_scale.description: Downscale applied to ASCII lowercase a-z by a small-caps font (a font name ending in ' SC', e.g. 'Dino SC'): the lowercase character renders as the base font's uppercase glyph uniformly shrunk to sc_scale of the cap height, top-down (the glyph's own bottom stays in place and its top descends). Uppercase and caseless characters engrave at full size; the nominal text_height is untouched (no cutter change). The same field drives the inline <sc> small-caps markup tag (the per-character selection); inert on a non-SC font carrying no <sc> run. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.7); explicit 0.2/1.0 are honored.
sc_scale.title: Sc Scale

supersubscript_downscale.description: Downscale applied to a bare <sup>/<sub> markup run: the run's glyphs engrave uniformly shrunk to this fraction of the line's size, and the baseline shift derives from it, centering the shrunken glyph on the line it belongs to (superscript rises 1 - d/2 cap heights, its centre landing on the capline; subscript drops d/2 cap heights, its centre landing on the baseline). The argumented forms <sup:0.3>/<sub:-0.2> set the shift explicitly (cap-height units) and apply no scaling, so this field is inert on them. The run engraves with the cutter for its downscaled height (the <scale:N> ladder). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.5); explicit 0.2/1.0 are honored.
supersubscript_downscale.title: Supersubscript Downscale

html_brackets.description: Delimiter pair for the inline markup syntax (<i> italic and future tags): an even-length string whose first half is the left delimiter and second half the right delimiter ('<>' -> '<' + '>', '<<>>' -> '<<' + '>>'). The halves must differ and contain no alphanumeric characters or newlines. A bracketed body that is not a registered tag engraves verbatim, so choosing a pair absent from the data keeps chevrons from being read as markup. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback '<>'); the slash is only special inside the delimiters.
html_brackets.title: Html Brackets

italic_angle.description: Slant angle in degrees for italic markup (<i>): PLT-extracted glyphs (and TTF glyphs with no native italic face) are sheared about the baseline, x' = x + y * tan(angle), so the baseline stays fixed and the glyph leans right. Bound to [0, 45]; 0 means upright (the shear is skipped). Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 12); explicit 0.0/45.0 are honored.
italic_angle.title: Italic Angle

underline_offset_fraction.description: Extra air for underline markup (<u>) as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): the underline centerline (cut with the line's own text cutter) sits cutter diameter + fraction * cap height below the baseline, so the engraved underline's top edge floats exactly that air below the engraved baseline stroke. The break test is strictly horizontal: a glyph breaks the underline where its ink crosses the underline's centerline, so raising it lifts the underline clear and stops it breaking. 0.0 = the underline's top edge touches the baseline stroke. Must be >= 0. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0); explicit 0.0 is honored.
underline_offset_fraction.title: Underline Offset Fraction

underline_break_clearance_fraction.description: Extra air at each underline (<u>) break as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): each cut is padded horizontally by 0.5 * cutter + fraction * cap height (the half cutter is the glyph stroke's own half-width), so the engraved air between a descending glyph's stroke and the underline's cut edge is exactly this value. 0.0 = the cut sits at the ink. Independent of underline_offset_fraction (which decides which glyphs break). Must be >= 0. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback 0.0); explicit 0.0 is honored.
underline_break_clearance_fraction.title: Underline Break Clearance Fraction

underline_break_spaces.description: Break an underline (<u>) at the spaces between words: false (default) draws one continuous underline across the whole underlined run (spaces included, broken only by descending glyphs); true ends the underline at each space so every word gets its own underline and the inter-word space stays bare. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit false is honored.
underline_break_spaces.title: Underline Break Spaces

strikethrough_offset_fraction.description: Strikethrough (<s>) height ABOVE the baseline as a fraction of the rendered cap height (capline - baseline): the stroke (cut with the line's own text cutter) sits fraction * cap height above the baseline, so 0.0 puts it on the baseline and 1.0 puts it on the capline. Unlike the underline the stroke is never broken -- a descender punches through it. null (default) centres the stroke on the cap-band midline (half the rendered cap height). Must be >= 0. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback null = mid-cap); explicit 0.0 is honored.
strikethrough_offset_fraction.title: Strikethrough Offset Fraction

strikethrough_break_spaces.description: Break a strikethrough (<s>) at the spaces between words: false (default) draws one continuous stroke across the whole struck run (spaces included); true ends the stroke at each space so every word gets its own strike and the inter-word space stays bare. Cascades line -> label -> job (fallback false); explicit false is honored.
strikethrough_break_spaces.title: Strikethrough Break Spaces

v_center_chars.description: Character set auto-centred vertically between the baseline and the capline: every text character occurring in this string is raised or lowered (a pure vertical translate) so its own ink is centred on the cap-band midline (half the rendered cap height above the baseline) - the characters a font typically draws too high (hyphen, colon, en/em dash, '=', '<', '>'). The inline <vc>...</vc> markup tag applies the same centering to any other characters it wraps. Empty string '' disables the auto-apply (the <vc> tag keeps working on its own). Cascades line -> label -> job (code fallback '' = auto-apply off; job-config.json ships the shop set '-:–—=<>'); an explicit '' is honored.
